rationale_CORRECTION01: P0_IN_EVIDENCE_ACQUISITION_PATH_CLOSED. The original ACT claimed the readout path is created lazily by the first appendFile call. That was wrong: Node's appendFile creates the FILE if missing but NOT the parent directory. On a clean dogfood profile where <dataRoot>/diagnostics/myc-prime-live-diag/ does not yet exist, the first append would reject with ENOENT. The detached .catch() in appendReadoutLine correctly prevented semantic damage, but the sink would silently produce zero evidence — straight back to CAPTURE_INSUFFICIENT. The reviewer caught this and demanded a single bounded fix: mkdir(parent, {recursive:true}) BEFORE appendFile in the production writer. This ACT (CORRECTION01) applies that fix and adds DLR-06 (a filesystem-level test that exercises the PRODUCTION writer topology against a real on-disk temp data root whose diagnostic subdir does not yet exist). PRE-FIX invariant: the subdir does not exist, stat throws ENOENT. POST-FIX invariant: the subdir is created by the writer and events.jsonl contains exactly one valid JSON line. DLR-06 also re-pins DLR-01.a (default-off still zero-I/O with the production writer bound) and DLR-05.a (write failure still non-fatal when the production writer rejects against an unresolvable data root).
rationale: EVIDENCE ACQUISITION (REVISED). The LIVE RED is REAL (frozen) but the in-process diagnostic Map was unobservable from outside the extension host. This ACT adds the smallest possible default-off JSONL readout sink so the next operator-driven ACT (RUN03) can apply the §17 discriminator tree to a real on-disk trace. The sink is gated on the SAME isMycPrimeLiveDiagEnabled() boolean as the existing recorders, so when disabled it produces zero file writes, zero async work, zero log lines (bit-identical invariant). The hot-path cost when enabled+unbound is one boolean + two typeof checks; when enabled+bound it adds one path resolution + one detached mkdir+appendFile dispatch. The Promise is never awaited, so beforeModel is never blocked. The detached mkdir creates the parent dir lazily — the diagnostic is default-off so we do NOT eagerly materialize an empty directory in production. Production semantics are bit-identical to the pre-ACT path on the disabled code path; the only observable production change is that the on-disk directory now materializes on first use (which the previous ACT claimed it would but didn't). 6 focused tests (DLR-01..DLR-06, 14 assertions) green; 19 existing live-diag tests continue green; 30 dogfood-diagnostic-profile tests continue green; 39 dogfood-diagnostic-profile-myc-clinemm01 tests continue green; 1230 bun unit tests continue green. check-types clean; lint clean; git diff --check clean. NO new env flag, no new diagnostic framework, no gRPC, no Command Palette, no MCP tool, no protocol change, no SQLite, no webview state, no new authority. NO repair of the LIVE RED is attempted; that is RUN03's job.
